newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: FORECAST - DUTCH COMPANY RESULTS DUE NOV 4.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - DUTCH COMPANY RESULTS DUE NOV 4.

text.p: Analysts' estimates of Dutch
company results for week beginning Monday, Nov 4 include:
DATE--COMPANY-------PERIOD--PFT/DIV--CONSENSUS--RANGE-----PVS
Profit figures are net profits before extraordinary items
and in millions of guilders unless otherwise stated.
* KLM net profit includes 115 million guilder book profit on
sale of Northwest preference shares plus revaluation of
Northwest prefs still held by KLM.
Securities houses surveyed included: Amstgeld, Bangert
Pontier, BZW, Delta Lloyd Bank, Generale Bank, ING, Kempen & Co,
Labouchere, Rabo/IRIS, NIB Strating and Wesselius.
NOTE - Banks and brokers interested in contributing to
Reuters surveys can contact the Amsterdam newsroom on
+31-20-504-5000 or fax their forecasts to +31-20-504 5040.
For the week starting Nov 11 we are collecting Q3 result
forecasts for Aegon and Stad Rotterdam.
